label: b26: pen0 (step penalty 0), seed 16 of 16, 50M
notes: Batch b26: the per-step movement penalty SNEK_STEP_PENALTY, one knob at four values (0.01, 0.001, 0.0001, 0) x 4 seeds, on b24's config (horizon anneal to 50% of the cap: lambda 0.95->0.999, gamma 0.99->0.999, entropy 0.01->0.001; lr 2.5e-4, epochs 4, mb 512, T 256, clip 0.2, huber, adv norm, grad 0.5, b2 reward, fc 320, 128 lanes) at 50M, seeds pinned to the arm letter. Motivation: docs/findings.md 2026-09-07 -- the best checkpoints fail by orbiting reachable food until they starve (257 of 280 failures over 60k games), a loop the reward made rational with a free step and a -0.5 starve against a -5 death. The penalty is subtracted on every step, terminal ones included. FIRST BATCH OF THE 26-VALUE OBSERVATION (era obs26-20260907: the perfect-game triple and the food-room value removed), so the pen0 cell is the control for the observation change and b24 (old era, 200M) is only a loose reference. Judged on perfect rate, and on the death split at close-out via tools.death_trace: a penalty that works turns starves down without raising sealed-food collisions. Needs a deploy of the observation change before it runs.
